title: Pagination
summary: Source-driven navigation for a collection split into numbered pages.

middle.description: Show page navigation and collection summary.

top-class.description: Framework utility classes for the show-more section.

main-class.description: Framework utility classes for the navigation section.

bottom-class.description: Framework utility classes for the batch-action section.

aria-label.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Result pages" in English).

pages-label.description: Visible label before page controls. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Pages:" in English).

page-label.description: Accessible prefix for a numbered page action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Page" in English).

previous-label.description: Accessible name of the previous-page action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Previous page" in English).

next-label.description: Accessible name of the next-page action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Next page" in English).

last-label.description: Visible label of the compatible last-page action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Last" in English).

total-label.description: Visible label for the total item count. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Total:" in English).

selected-label.description: Visible label for the selected item count. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Selected:" in English).

selected-count.description: Selected item count, clamped between zero and total.

show-more-text.description: Label of the compatible show-more action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Show more" in English).

page-size.description: Positive number of items per page.

show-page-size.description: Show the page-size selector for a non-empty collection.

page-size-label.description: Visible and accessible label of the page-size selector. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Per page:" in English).

show-actions.description: Show batch actions when actions are supplied.

action-apply-text.description: Label of the batch-action apply button. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Apply" in English).

action-for-all-label.description: Label of the all-items toggle. Empty: the text of the page's language ("For all" in English).

actions-label.description: Accessible name of the batch-action selector. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Action for the selected records" in English).

action-choose-label.description: Placeholder of the batch-action selector, shown until an action is chosen. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Choose an action" in English).

actions-region-label.description: Accessible name of the panel that appears while rows are marked. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Actions for the selected" in English).

clear-selection-label.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the control that drops the selection. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Clear the selection" in English).

count-known.description: Whether the number of records is known. A host that does not count every answer sets it false, and the view offers the number instead of showing it.

can-count.description: Whether the host can count on request. Without it the view offers nothing and asks for nothing.

counting.description: A count is on its way; the view shows a short wait in place of the number.

has-next.description: Whether a further page exists. It is what moves forward and Show more when no total was sent.

show-count-label.description: Text of the control that asks the host for the number. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Show the number" in English).

counting-label.description: Accessible name of the short wait shown while the count is on its way. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Counting" in English).

first-label.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the control that goes to the first page. Empty: the text of the page's language ("First" in English).

page-field-label.description: Label of the field that takes a page number. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Page:" in English).

show-more-busy.description: Mark the Show more control as working while the host fetches the next portion; it is disabled and shows a loader.

size.description: The step of the size ladder its fields, buttons, labels and page numbers take: 1, or the dense 1/2 of an admin.

item_contract.page: Positive one-based page number bounded by total and page-size.

navigation.const: The visible root is a named nav; page actions are native buttons because the component emits state events instead of owning URLs.

current.const: Exactly one rendered page exposes aria-current=page when total is greater than zero.

empty.const: A zero-sized collection renders no page controls and emits no page-change.

responsive.const: A long desktop range keeps edge pages and static ellipses; a narrow range keeps the current page, adjacent pages and directional actions on one line.

composition.const: Show-more, page-size and batch-action sections remain compatible optional compositions; data loading and host actions stay outside the component.

getTopSection.summary: Returns the top section element (.sf-pagination-top), or null when it is not rendered.

getMainSection.summary: Returns the main section element (.sf-pagination-main), or null when it is not rendered.

getBottomSection.summary: Returns the bottom section element (.sf-pagination-bottom), or null when it is not rendered.

goToPage.summary: Moves to a page: the number is parsed as an integer and clamped to 1..pageCount when the count is known (only to at least 1 when it is not). Emits sf-page-change when the page actually changes; does nothing when the total is a known zero.

showMore.summary: Emits sf-show-more with the current paging and the given item; performs no request and changes no state.

setPageSize.summary: Sets a positive page size, keeps the current page within the new page count and emits sf-page-size-change. A non-positive, non-numeric or unchanged size is ignored.

setAction.summary: Selects a batch action by value (an empty value clears the choice) and emits sf-action-change when it differs from the current one.

setActionForAll.summary: Sets whether the batch action applies to every record under the filter and emits sf-action-for-all-change. Turning it on also requests the count (sf-count-request with reason action-for-all) when the count is not yet known.

setState.summary: Writes each key as its kebab-case attribute: false, null, undefined or an empty string removes the attribute, true sets it empty, anything else is stringified.

onPageChange.summary: Adds a listener for sf-page-change; the handler is called with (current, detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

onShowMore.summary: Adds a listener for sf-show-more; the handler is called with (detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

item.description: What showMore was called with; the built-in button passes its click target.

accessibility.focus: Tab reaches only enabled native actions. Focus uses the shared keyboard-only focus-visible treatment and remains visible in forced colors; omitted pages are not focusable.

changes: Fix: the action-for-all checkbox follows the checkbox state (change) instead of toggling on click, so clicking its label no longer toggles twice and leaves it off.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-pagination for a collection divided into numbered pages when the host owns data loading and reacts to pagination events.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not use Pagination for semantic steps or short content that can be shown at once
Do not make an ellipsis interactive or put the pagination row on multiple lines
Do not treat the optional batch-action section as the core pagination contract
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-pagination aria-label="Страницы результатов поиска" current="2" total="96" page-size="10" top="false" bottom="false" show-page-size="false"></sf-pagination>
